items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Well, it's like Mel Lewis. If the guy wouldn't ask the questions, and he wouldn't have nothing to say.

ctx.x: I know it. I don't envy Nat, he's going to have his -- well, maybe Nat will come at it from a whole other angle. [NAT HENTOFF]
Well, it's like Mel Lewis. If the guy wouldn't ask the questions, and he wouldn't have nothing to say.
That's right, nothing the matter with that at all. People know what they got to say and then say it and don't say anything else, I got to respect that.
